name: Opens Pull Request
description: The account or App that opened the pull request. `author_association` says what the author was to the repository at the time — a MEMBER's proposal and a first-time contributor's are different admissions to the same gate.

author_association.description: GitHub's `CommentAuthorAssociation` for the author on this repository (OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR, CONTRIBUTOR, FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR, FIRST_TIMER, NONE, MANNEQUIN) — settles whether the proposal came from inside or outside the trust boundary.
